jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
jobs.description:
**Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.**
------------------------------------------------------------


Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.  

  

Our AI\-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self\-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.  

  

As an AI\-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.


The Chief Information Security Officer will be responsible for defining, leading, and advancing Spring Health’s enterprise\-wide information security, technology risk, compliance, and IT strategy. This leader will ensure the protection of company assets, customer data, member data, provider data, and critical systems while enabling business growth, innovation, and operational scale.


Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, the CISO will lead the company’s Information Security, Compliance/GRC, and IT functions, including Security Operations, Application/Product Security, cloud and infrastructure security, identity and access management, third\-party risk, incident response, enterprise compliance, corporate IT, and business technology operations. This leader will manage and partner closely with senior security and IT leaders, including the VP, Information Security.


The CISO will serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and the Board on cybersecurity risk, regulatory readiness, enterprise resilience, customer trust, and technology risk. They will play a critical role in Spring Health’s next phase of scale, including the integration of Alma, enterprise customer growth, AI transformation, international expansion, and readiness for future public\-company expectations.


This leader will be responsible for building a security and IT organization that enables the business, supports product velocity, protects sensitive healthcare data, and earns the trust of customers, members, providers, partners, regulators, and employees.


Please note that this is a **hybrid role based in either New York City or San Francisco**, with an expectation to be in the office 2–3 days per week. Candidates must be based in the NYC or SF metro areas or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Frequent travel will be required for leadership meetings and to visit various office locations.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and execute Spring Health’s enterprise\-wide information security, compliance, technology risk, and IT strategy in alignment with company priorities, growth plans, and regulatory obligations.
* Lead the Information Security, Compliance/GRC, and IT organizations, including Security Operations, Application/Product Security, cloud and infrastructure security, enterprise compliance, corporate IT, identity and access management, and business technology operations.
* Partner closely with the CTO, executive leadership team, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, People, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure security and IT enable the business rather than create unnecessary friction.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and the Board on cybersecurity risks, technology risk, regulatory readiness, incident response, enterprise resilience, customer trust, and security investments.
* Build and scale a high\-performing organization across security, compliance, and IT, including developing leaders, clarifying ownership, improving operating rhythms, and ensuring the team has the right structure, capabilities, and culture for Spring’s next stage of growth.
* Oversee enterprise security operations, including threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, security monitoring, endpoint security, SIEM strategy, threat intelligence, and resilience exercises.
* Ensure Spring Health’s Application/Product Security and cloud security programs are deeply embedded in the software development lifecycle, including secure architecture, threat modeling, automated testing, vulnerability remediation, and security review processes.
* Own the enterprise compliance and information security risk management program, including risk assessments, risk registers, risk treatment plans, control frameworks, policy governance, and executive reporting.
* Ensure successful compliance outcomes across applicable frameworks and regulations, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, CCPA, and other healthcare, privacy, and security requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Privacy on data protection, privacy, regulatory obligations, Business Associate Agreements, customer commitments, breach assessment, notification obligations, and evolving healthcare security requirements.
* Lead security and IT strategy related to the Alma integration, including systems, data flows, access controls, compliance obligations, enterprise risk, provider/member/customer data protection, and long\-term operating model decisions.
* Define and govern Spring Health’s AI security strategy, including enterprise AI guardrails, approved tool usage, data classification, model/tool risk assessment, secure AI adoption, and protection of sensitive healthcare and business data.
* Oversee corporate IT and business technology operations, including employee technology experience, endpoint management, access lifecycle, SaaS

jobs.title: Director of IT
jobs.description:
The IT Director oversees all aspects of the school's information technology infrastructure, systems, and services. The IT Director assumes management responsibilities for the direction, coordination, integration, and implementation of technology across the school and departments. The Director of IT will be responsible for planning, purchasing, installing, and maintaining the school's physical technology systems in a condition of excellence, always enabling full educational use of technology in compliance with local, state, and federal regulations and requirements.


**Essential Responsibilities*** **Vendor \& Stakeholder Management** \-

	+ Serve as primary contact for outsourced IT vendor(s).
	+ Collaborate with the Director of Finance to coordinate the procurement process of IT assets.
	+ Develop a plan for technology distribution and maintenance of IT assets in collaboration with the leadership.
	+ Ensure that all members of the CSLSJ community have access to the high\-quality, functioning technology they need to achieve high levels of success.
	+ In collaboration with the Executive Director, maintain a network\-wide technology budget.
	+ Manage the federal e\-rate process, ensuring that the school can maximize federal funding allocations.
* **Technology Integration** \-

	+ Leads and establishes the network and schools in technology integration, ensuring student use of technologies in service to the curriculum.
	+ Serves as a source of information on trends, research, applications, and effective practices related to technology use within the curriculum.
	+ Organize and lead professional development, training, and meetings with key stakeholders to support network and school staff in using technology to drive overall performance.
	+ Develop and implement a network\-wide strategic plan for utilizing technology to support and enhance teaching and learning. This plan may include:
		- Individualized learning pathways.
		- Technology\-assisted formative assessment and data analysis.
		- Use of technology to deliver instruction.
* **Daily Operations** \-

	+ Maintain hardware and software for all computer systems infrastructure.
		- Including server configuration and maintenance, software installation, and upgrades.
		- Copy, print, and fax machines.
	+ Develop and maintain a system for technology equipment checkouts and check\-ins.
	+ Maintain an online system for technical support and services.
	+ Maintain wireless and LAN connectivity for all users.
	+ Provide troubleshooting support for all technical\-related issues. Track and escalate issues as appropriate.
	+ Develop systems to assist in the implementation of technology\-based tools in the classroom.
	+ Assist with professional development classes for teachers and students on technology\-based tools.
	+ Set up equipment for presentations/assemblies; oversee troubleshooting as needed.
	+ Manage VOIP phone system and internet connectivity.
	+ Manage Interactive Board and projectors.

**Knowledge and skills*** Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex or technical concepts clearly to non\-technical audiences.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with diverse stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with excellent attention to detail and a proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and systems\-thinking skills, with the ability to identify needs and implement effective systems and practices that support school operations.
* Strong supervisory and leadership skills.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take initiative with minimal supervision.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and, at times, stressful school environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, PowerSchool, educational AI platforms, data management tools, and other related technology and software.

**Supervisory Responsibility**This position has supervisory responsibilities.**Work environment**
--------------------

* Model professional and ethical standards when dealing with students, parents, peers, and the community
* Model professional maturity in leading students toward their academic, career, and cultural growth
* Establish and maintain a cooperative working relationship with students, parents, and schools.
* Participate in training and professional development about various pedagogical competencies.
* Meet professional obligations through efficient work habits such as: meeting deadlines, honoring schedules, and collaborating effectively with colleagues.
* All work responsibilities are subject to performance goals and targets established as part of the annual performance planning process.

**Physical Demands**
--------------------

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. This position is very active and requires standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping, crouching, and climbing. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Traveling long and short distances.

jobs.title: Chief Information Officer
jobs.description:
The Chief Information Officer is accountable for the strategy, security, stability, architecture, and performance of ACCC's technology environment. This leader translates business priorities into a disciplined technology roadmap, protects client and organizational data, strengthens the reliability and recoverability of critical systems, and builds an operating model that delivers measurable business value. The CIO leads Information Technology and serves as the senior technology advisor to the Chief Operating Officer, Chief Executive Officer, Executive Leadership Team, and Board as requested.


The role requires a hands\-on and strategic leader who can stabilize current operations while modernizing legacy platforms, improving delivery discipline, strengthening vendor accountability, and developing a capable technology team. The CIO will establish clear priorities, transparent governance, reliable service levels, and sound controls across infrastructure, applications, data, cybersecurity, support, development, and third\-party technology services.

*This job description does not limit management’s ability to assign or adjust duties and responsibilities at any time.*

**Technology Strategy and Business Alignment**

* Develop and maintain a multiyear enterprise technology strategy and roadmap aligned with ACCC's mission, operating plan, growth goals, client experience priorities, compliance obligations, and financial capacity.
* Convert organizational priorities into a sequenced portfolio of technology investments with clear outcomes, ownership, dependencies, costs, risks, and target dates.
* Serve as a trusted executive advisor on technology opportunities, constraints, risk, capacity, and tradeoffs, using plain language and decision ready recommendations.
* Partners with Product and Digital, Counseling, Client Support, Disbursements, Marketing, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, and other business leaders to improve client and employee experiences.
* Establish an operating model that protects capacity for stability and security, critical business delivery, and incident response while making competing priorities visible.

**Operational Stability and Service Management**

* Own the availability, performance, capacity, and support of business\-critical systems, infrastructure, networks, databases, telecommunications, endpoints, cloud services, and integrations.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Annapurna Labs
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon that powers AWS's machine learning infrastructure, including the Trainium and Inferentia chip families. Our next\-generation ML accelerator is a multi\-die chiplet using state\-of\-the\-art packaging technology, and it is the most complex hardware program Amazon has undertaken. We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own end\-to\-end program execution for this chip, from RTL freeze through tape\-out and into production readiness.  

  

This is not a status\-reporting role. You will be the person who connects a sprawling set of engineering workstreams into a single coherent schedule, identifies the real critical path week to week, and drives the cross\-functional decisions that keep the program on track. The program spans multiple concurrent silicon development efforts with significant interdependencies across engineering disciplines, external partners, and infrastructure.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Own the integrated schedule and critical path analysis across multiple die tape\-outs through engineering samples and production ramp. Understand dependency chains deeply enough to calculate the impact of any slip or pull\-in, and update the timeline weekly with real data.  

Drive the weekly chip status cadence by synthesizing inputs from RTL/DV, physical design, packaging, power, infrastructure, and post\-silicon teams into a single view that tells leadership where we actually stand, including what is getting worse and what needs action.  

Track verification convergence as a leading indicator by monitoring the progression from feature completion through RTL closure, bug trends, and regression pass rates by block. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive the engineering response before downstream milestones are affected.  

Manage the external design partner interface, owning the netlist delivery calendar, tracking your partner's physical design timeline, and negotiating schedule trades with a clear understanding of downstream cost.  

Drive infrastructure readiness and external IP delivery by partnering with compute and EDA platform teams on capacity planning, and tracking third\-party PHY, memory interface, and controller IP deliveries against consuming blocks to escalate gaps before they become tape\-out critical.  

  

A day in the life  

You start your morning reviewing verification convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug closure rates haven't flattened. You pull the DV lead and RTL owner into a quick sync to agree on a recovery plan before the weekly chip status review. In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects a netlist delivery shift from your external design partner, quantifying the downstream impact on tape\-out timing. After lunch, you join an infrastructure capacity review to confirm that compute clusters can handle the regression load through freeze, then close out the day preparing an executive summary for an upcoming program milestone review.  

  

About the team  

The Annapurna Labs ML Accelerator team builds the Trainium and Inferentia silicon that trains and serves machine learning models across AWS. We work at the intersection of chip architecture, physical design, verification, and infrastructure to deliver products that push the boundaries of performance and efficiency for our customers. Our team values people who bring strong technical judgment, clear communication, and a willingness to get into the details. If you want to shape how Amazon builds its most ambitious hardware and work alongside talented engineers solving real problems at scale, this is the role for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
* 10\+ years of hands\-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* 10\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* Deep working knowledge of the chip development lifecycle: RTL verification milestones, physical design convergence, DFT, and timing closure.
* Experience managing programs with external design partners and IP vendors where you don't control the resources but own the outcome.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with real dependency modeling — not just Gantt charts, but an understanding of which paths have float and which don't.
* Strong technical communication skills: ability to present crisp status to VP\-level audiences, distinguishing signal from noise, and framing decisions clearly.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with multi\-die / chiplet / advanced packaging programs (2\.5D/3D integration).
* Familiarity with HBM integration, die\-to\-die interfaces, or high\-speed serial subsystems.
* Experience with leading\-edge foundry nodes and their specific flow and schedule characteristics.
* Background in ML accelerator or high\-performance compute silicon.
* Experience driving infrastructure capacity planning for large\-scale chip development programs.

new_jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
new_jobs.description:
**Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.**
------------------------------------------------------------


Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.  

  

Our AI\-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self\-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.  

  

As an AI\-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.


The Chief Information Security Officer will be responsible for defining, leading, and advancing Spring Health’s enterprise\-wide information security, technology risk, compliance, and IT strategy. This leader will ensure the protection of company assets, customer data, member data, provider data, and critical systems while enabling business growth, innovation, and operational scale.


Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, the CISO will lead the company’s Information Security, Compliance/GRC, and IT functions, including Security Operations, Application/Product Security, cloud and infrastructure security, identity and access management, third\-party risk, incident response, enterprise compliance, corporate IT, and business technology operations. This leader will manage and partner closely with senior security and IT leaders, including the VP, Information Security.


The CISO will serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and the Board on cybersecurity risk, regulatory readiness, enterprise resilience, customer trust, and technology risk. They will play a critical role in Spring Health’s next phase of scale, including the integration of Alma, enterprise customer growth, AI transformation, international expansion, and readiness for future public\-company expectations.


This leader will be responsible for building a security and IT organization that enables the business, supports product velocity, protects sensitive healthcare data, and earns the trust of customers, members, providers, partners, regulators, and employees.


Please note that this is a **hybrid role based in either New York City or San Francisco**, with an expectation to be in the office 2–3 days per week. Candidates must be based in the NYC or SF metro areas or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Frequent travel will be required for leadership meetings and to visit various office locations.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and execute Spring Health’s enterprise\-wide information security, compliance, technology risk, and IT strategy in alignment with company priorities, growth plans, and regulatory obligations.
* Lead the Information Security, Compliance/GRC, and IT organizations, including Security Operations, Application/Product Security, cloud and infrastructure security, enterprise compliance, corporate IT, identity and access management, and business technology operations.
* Partner closely with the CTO, executive leadership team, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, People, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure security and IT enable the business rather than create unnecessary friction.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and the Board on cybersecurity risks, technology risk, regulatory readiness, incident response, enterprise resilience, customer trust, and security investments.
* Build and scale a high\-performing organization across security, compliance, and IT, including developing leaders, clarifying ownership, improving operating rhythms, and ensuring the team has the right structure, capabilities, and culture for Spring’s next stage of growth.
* Oversee enterprise security operations, including threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, security monitoring, endpoint security, SIEM strategy, threat intelligence, and resilience exercises.
* Ensure Spring Health’s Application/Product Security and cloud security programs are deeply embedded in the software development lifecycle, including secure architecture, threat modeling, automated testing, vulnerability remediation, and security review processes.
* Own the enterprise compliance and information security risk management program, including risk assessments, risk registers, risk treatment plans, control frameworks, policy governance, and executive reporting.
* Ensure successful compliance outcomes across applicable frameworks and regulations, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, CCPA, and other healthcare, privacy, and security requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Privacy on data protection, privacy, regulatory obligations, Business Associate Agreements, customer commitments, breach assessment, notification obligations, and evolving healthcare security requirements.
* Lead security and IT strategy related to the Alma integration, including systems, data flows, access controls, compliance obligations, enterprise risk, provider/member/customer data protection, and long\-term operating model decisions.
* Define and govern Spring Health’s AI security strategy, including enterprise AI guardrails, approved tool usage, data classification, model/tool risk assessment, secure AI adoption, and protection of sensitive healthcare and business data.
* Oversee corporate IT and business technology operations, including employee technology experience, endpoint management, access lifecycle, SaaS

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon that powers AWS's machine learning infrastructure, including the Trainium and Inferentia chip families. Our next\-generation ML accelerator is a multi\-die chiplet using state\-of\-the\-art packaging technology, and it is the most complex hardware program Amazon has undertaken. We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own end\-to\-end program execution for this chip, from RTL freeze through tape\-out and into production readiness.  

  

This is not a status\-reporting role. You will be the person who connects a sprawling set of engineering workstreams into a single coherent schedule, identifies the real critical path week to week, and drives the cross\-functional decisions that keep the program on track. The program spans multiple concurrent silicon development efforts with significant interdependencies across engineering disciplines, external partners, and infrastructure.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Own the integrated schedule and critical path analysis across multiple die tape\-outs through engineering samples and production ramp. Understand dependency chains deeply enough to calculate the impact of any slip or pull\-in, and update the timeline weekly with real data.  

Drive the weekly chip status cadence by synthesizing inputs from RTL/DV, physical design, packaging, power, infrastructure, and post\-silicon teams into a single view that tells leadership where we actually stand, including what is getting worse and what needs action.  

Track verification convergence as a leading indicator by monitoring the progression from feature completion through RTL closure, bug trends, and regression pass rates by block. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive the engineering response before downstream milestones are affected.  

Manage the external design partner interface, owning the netlist delivery calendar, tracking your partner's physical design timeline, and negotiating schedule trades with a clear understanding of downstream cost.  

Drive infrastructure readiness and external IP delivery by partnering with compute and EDA platform teams on capacity planning, and tracking third\-party PHY, memory interface, and controller IP deliveries against consuming blocks to escalate gaps before they become tape\-out critical.  

  

A day in the life  

You start your morning reviewing verification convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug closure rates haven't flattened. You pull the DV lead and RTL owner into a quick sync to agree on a recovery plan before the weekly chip status review. In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects a netlist delivery shift from your external design partner, quantifying the downstream impact on tape\-out timing. After lunch, you join an infrastructure capacity review to confirm that compute clusters can handle the regression load through freeze, then close out the day preparing an executive summary for an upcoming program milestone review.  

  

About the team  

The Annapurna Labs ML Accelerator team builds the Trainium and Inferentia silicon that trains and serves machine learning models across AWS. We work at the intersection of chip architecture, physical design, verification, and infrastructure to deliver products that push the boundaries of performance and efficiency for our customers. Our team values people who bring strong technical judgment, clear communication, and a willingness to get into the details. If you want to shape how Amazon builds its most ambitious hardware and work alongside talented engineers solving real problems at scale, this is the role for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
* 10\+ years of hands\-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* 10\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* Deep working knowledge of the chip development lifecycle: RTL verification milestones, physical design convergence, DFT, and timing closure.
* Experience managing programs with external design partners and IP vendors where you don't control the resources but own the outcome.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with real dependency modeling — not just Gantt charts, but an understanding of which paths have float and which don't.
* Strong technical communication skills: ability to present crisp status to VP\-level audiences, distinguishing signal from noise, and framing decisions clearly.

* Experience with multi\-die / chiplet / advanced packaging programs (2\.5D/3D integration).
* Familiarity with HBM integration, die\-to\-die interfaces, or high\-speed serial subsystems.
* Experience with leading\-edge foundry nodes and their specific flow and schedule characteristics.
* Background in ML accelerator or high\-performance compute silicon.
* Experience driving infrastructure capacity planning for large\-scale chip development programs.
